description.zh: 购买IP实例ID,多个英文逗号隔开；来源于DedicatedIpNonePoolList接口返回IP购买实例ID
description.en: The IDs of the purchased IP instances. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can obtain the instance IDs from the response of the DedicatedIpNonePoolList operation.

description.zh:
IP池名称；
长度为1-50个字符，允许英文字母、数字、_、-，IP池创建后，名称不可修改
description.en: The name of the IP pool. The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The name cannot be changed after the IP pool is created.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dm dedicated-ip-pool-create --name xxx --buy-resource-ids xxx,xxx --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
